sentences.en: The sooner you get your ticket, the cheaper the fare.
sentences.zh: 越早买到票，票价就越便宜。

sentences.en: Thus he, reproaching. Towards the town they fare / in haste.
sentences.zh: 于是他埋怨着。向着城镇他们急忙赶去。

sentences.en: I think I would fare better with heavier sports shoes.
sentences.zh: 我觉得穿运动鞋会更舒服些。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：若愿与我同行，我不在乎（care）船费（fare）
